title: Discrete MeanFlow: One-Step Generation via Conditional Transition Kernels
abstract: arXiv:2605.12805v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: MeanFlow enables one-step generation in continuous spaces by learning an average velocity over a time interval rather than the instantaneous velocity field of flow matching. However, discrete state spaces lack smooth trajectories or spatial derivatives, so the continuous formulation does not directly apply. We introduce Discrete MeanFlow, a theoretical finite-state formulation that replaces point motion with probability-mass transport. Our key object is the conditional transition kernel of a continuous-time Markov chain (CTMC), from which we define a mean discrete rate that measures average transition-probability change over a finite interval. We prove a Discrete MeanFlow identity that relates this finite-interval rate to the instantaneous CTMC generator at the endpoint, using the Kolmogorov forward equation in place of the spatial chain rule in continuous MeanFlow. translated_title: 离散MeanFlow：基于条件转移核的单步生成
translated_abstract: MeanFlow通过学习时间区间上的平均速度而非流匹配的瞬时速度场，实现了连续空间中的单步生成。然而，离散状态空间缺乏平滑轨迹或空间导数，因此连续形式无法直接适用。我们提出了离散MeanFlow（Discrete MeanFlow），一种针对有限状态空间的理论形式化方法，用概率质量输运取代点的运动。我们的核心对象是连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC）的条件转移核，并由此定义了平均离散速率，用以衡量有限区间内转移概率的平均变化。我们证明了一个离散MeanFlow恒等式，该恒等式利用Kolmogorov前向方程（取代连续MeanFlow中的空间链式法则），将有限区间速率与端点处的瞬时CTMC生成元联系起来。我们直接对转移核进行参数化（原文此处截断）。
tldr: 提出离散MeanFlow理论框架，以连续时间马尔可夫链的条件转移核为基础定义平均离散速率，并证明离散MeanFlow恒等式，从而将单步生成方法从连续空间扩展到离散状态空间。
en_tdlr: Introduces Discrete MeanFlow, a finite-state formulation that defines an average discrete rate over CTMC conditional transition kernels and proves a Discrete MeanFlow identity, extending one-step generation from continuous to discrete state spaces.
